_comment: harness-loop create-seed (plan 032, modernized from the 024 schema-only stub). The CLI consumes `cursor` (→ nav.now) + `nodes` VERBATIM; root identity (provenance/created_at/events/nav block) is stamped by `harness flow create`. The ⚙️ engineering loop eng-harness-flow drives standalone (own .harness/loop.flow.json) when no the-flow is active. The cycle is modeled as a nav RESET (the driver moves nav.now back to observe/boot) — the DAG stays ACYCLIC (improve.next:[]). retro is split into retro-drain (post-coding) + retro-harvest (post-flight); drain-gate is the decision that orders them. The four fire-hook nodes carry their `command` so the standalone loop is self-documenting; observe/improve/drain-gate fire no hook. Zones are explicit (renderer ZONE_BY_TYPE has no loop types — R-3).
